audit.description: Changed production code in bpemb/util.py removes the direct requests import and imports the real pycurl package inside http_get_temp. The diff shows meaningful pycurl API use through pycurl.Curl(), setopt() with pycurl.URL, FOLLOWLOCATION, SSL_VERIFYPEER, SSL_VERIFYHOST, HEADERFUNCTION, WRITEFUNCTION, perform(), getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE), and close(). Dynamic evidence also reports target events from production repo code with pycurl loaded from site-packages, while source requests imports are only from third-party smart_open dependencies and not from production repo code.
evidence: Unified diff: bpemb/util.py changes import requests to import pycurl and replaces requests.get/iter_content with pycurl.Curl API calls
Dynamic evidence: target_import and target_attr_access events for pycurl from bpemb/util.py, with origin under site-packages/pycurl.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so
Dynamic metrics: source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0 and source_imports_from_repo_count=0; requests imports only appear under site-packages/smart_open
Static evidence: bpemb/util.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false, target_provider_added=false
Dependency metadata diff replaces requests with pycurl in requirements.txt, setup.py, bpemb.egg-info/PKG-INFO, and bpemb.egg-info/requires.txt
reasons: bpemb/util.py meaningfully uses pycurl in changed production code
No changed production code imports or dynamically uses requests according to static and dynamic evidence
No local fake pycurl provider or shim is indicated; target origin is the installed pycurl extension
